title: Dell security advisory (AV26-886)
description: As of September 7, 2026, Dell is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Dell OpenManage Network Integration
	Prior to 3.10 or later

Dell iDRAC9
	Versions prior to 7.30.10.50 and 7.00.00.184

Dell iDRAC10
	Prior to 1.30.30.50 or later

Dell PowerEdge Server for Intel 2026
	Multiple versions and models

Dell Open Manage Python SDK (omsdk)
	Prior to 1.2.519 or later

Dell Networker Virtual Edition (NVE)
	Multiple versions

Dell PowerProtect DP Series Appliance
	Multiple versions

Dell Integrated Data Protection Appliance (IDPA)
	Multiple versions
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
